dialogues.title: Introducing: Antonio & Lina (Page 53)
dialogues.context: Se requede di sequer la conversazzion intrà Antonio é Lina.

turns.speaker: Antonio
turns.ionian: Salve! Mi clamo Antonio. Com ti clami?
turns.english: Hello! My name is Antonio. What is your name?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.english: Hello, Antonio! My name is Lina.

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.english: I am well, thank you! And you?

dialogues.title: Asking and Telling About Health (Page 54)
dialogues.context: Se requede di sequer la conversazzion intrà Antonio é Lina.

turns.speaker: Antonio
turns.ionian: Sto bene. È solo qe ajo um ponoqéfalo
turns.english: I am fine. It's just that I have a headache.

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.ionian: Aj! Ajì qualcosa qe posso facer?
turns.english: Oh no! Is there something I can do?

turns.speaker: Antonio
turns.english: I think that I should drink something.

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.ionian: Ajì unu cafetoriu qe cognoscio. Non è luntanu.
turns.english: There's a café that I know. It's not far.

dialogues.title: Doing Business in a Café (Page 55)
dialogues.context: Se requede di sequer la conversazzion intrà Antonio, Lina é la barista.

turns.speaker: Antonio
turns.ionian: Intunce, voliri una coppa d'espresso, unu biqer d'aqua éd un crescont, per favor.
turns.english: Well then, I would like to get a cup of espresso, a glass of water and a croissant, please.

turns.speaker: Barista
turns.english: Would you like anything else, signor?

turns.speaker: Antonio
turns.ionian: Sto bene. Però Lina, placessi magnar qualcosa?
turns.english: I'm fine. But Lina, would you like to eat something?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.ionian: Sì, voliri una gelacrema, unu biqer d'aqua éd un cafè, per favor.
turns.english: Yes, I would like an ice cream, a glass of water and a coffee, please.

turns.speaker: Barista
turns.ionian: Perfeto! Un cafè, un'espresso, dua biqeri d'aqua, una gelacrema éd un crescont. Sarria undece denari... Benfacì! Dimurierà um momento, per favor.
turns.english: Perfect! A coffee, an espresso, two glasses of water, an ice cream and a croissant. It will be eleven denarii... Thank you! It will take a moment, please.

turns.speaker: Speaker
turns.english: I would love to / I would like it
